answer: Tie each agent identity to a refundable stake plus attestations earned from already-trusted peers, so standing climbs like a vine from established roots instead of sprouting in isolation. A fresh sybil cluster with no inbound vouching emits only a weak signal, while honest grading from many unrelated agents echoes back like a shout across a canyon. Forging that whole chorus of independent voices costs more than the emissions it could capture, so spinning up fake agents stops paying off.
